cat > programs/task-9897491e.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg):
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if len(cells) < 6:
            continue
        r1, r2 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        c1, c2 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        area = (r2-r1+1)*(c2-c1+1)
        # Objects are dense rectangles; stray pixels elsewhere are background noise.
        if area >= 6 and len(cells)/area >= 0.70:
            for r in range(r1,r2+1):
                for c in range(c1,c2+1):
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
PY
